verdict.rationale: Airbyte Cloud's dbt Cloud integration explicitly runs dbt transformations 'immediately following syncs,' directly matching the story of transformations firing off freshly loaded data rather than a blind timer. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of this trigger-based behavior, clarity on whether self-hosted OSS supports the same immediate-trigger integration (vs. only Cloud), and detail on how it handles non-dbt-Cloud (local dbt project) transformations.
